H1.rule: zero-shot GENCO active-power residual >= 10 × the DC power-flow residual on the absolute test pool

H2.rule: B and C mean nodal power-balance error (PBE) <= 0.1 × zero-shot on the absolute test pool (seed mean)

H3.rule: C PV import slope ratio <= 0.25 on the test pairs in >= 2 of 3 seeds

H4.rule: D PV import slope ratio in [0.8, 1.2] AND PV import relative error <= 0.25 on the test pairs in >= 2 of 3 seeds (E5d RS1/RS2)

H5.rule: for D (seed mean): import MAE on the absolute test pool > 5 MW (E5d ST4 tolerance) AND, on the PV test pairs, the per-state import error >= 10 × the error of the predicted PV-induced import change

H6.rule: for D (seed mean, absolute test pool): global sign coherence |Σ_i r_i| / Σ_i |r_i| >= 0.5 (E6 diagnostic definition; Sundon E5d 0.57)

H7.rule: H4 holds in all 3 D seeds (stable) — otherwise reported as unstable
